Mission Local reported that MEDA acquired a 35-unit apartment building at 2059–2065 Mission Street in 2024 for $11.35 million. The building is part of the city’s Small Sites program, which aims to prevent tenant displacement and keep rents affordable. In October 2026, supervisors advanced a $22.2 million financing agreement tied to the building, after delaying a vote amid concerns about MEDA’s financial management.
